standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies, at each induction step, the embedding M_i to I_i whose cokernel continues the resolution and whose two-term structure produces the graded pieces.

standard_prerequisites.name: Injectivity of products of shifted duals and the right-resolution spectral sequence
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, Lemma lemma-source-graded-injective; Homology, Lemma homology-lemma-good-right-resolution-gives-qis
standard_prerequisites.use: Shows the filtration inclusions are admissible monomorphisms, and turns the constructed co-resolution into the quasi-isomorphism M to I.

core_obligations: The inductive co-resolution (proof lines 2716-2727): starting from M_0 = M choose short exact sequences 0 to M_i to I_i to M_{i+1} to 0 with the embeddings from lemma-good-sub, producing the co-resolution chain starting at M.

The total module (proof lines 2728-2741): I has graded parts the products over i of I_i^{n-i} with the total-complex differential d_I(x) = f_i(x) + (-1)^i d(x); with these conventions I is a differential graded A-module.

The property (I) filtration (proof lines 2742-2749): interleaving the two-step filtrations of the I_i gives differential graded submodules F_{2i}I and F_{2i+1}I whose successive quotients are products of shifts of A-dual, and by lemma-source-graded-injective the inclusions F_{i+1}I to F_iI are admissible monomorphisms.
The quasi-isomorphism (proof lines 2750-2752): the augmentation M to I_0 inside I is a quasi-isomorphism by the standard right-resolution lemma of Homology.
proof_roadmap: Build the co-resolution chain by iterating the good-sub embeddings.
Assemble the total differential graded module as the product with its explicit differential.
Interleave the two-step filtrations to get the property (I) filtration with admissible inclusions.
Conclude the augmentation is a quasi-isomorphism through the homology co-resolution lemma.
difficulty_reason: The lemma constructs, for every differential graded A-module, a quasi-isomorphic embedding into a module with property (I) (statement lines 2707-2717). The proof (lines 2719-2752) mirrors the resolution construction on the injective side, with the genuine work in the span: the inductive co-resolution from the good-sub embeddings, the product-total assembly with explicit grading and signed differential, the interleaved filtration whose graded pieces are products of shifts of A-dual with admissible inclusions verified through the injectivity lemma, and the closing quasi-isomorphism from the homology co-resolution lemma. H2: the product-variant assembly of the property (I) filtration is the non-formal content; this lemma is the injective twin of the property-(P) resolution and drives the property-(I) reductions of the chapter.
